name: New Year and Arbitrary Arrangement
description: You are given three integers k , p a and p b . You will construct a sequence with the following algorithm: Initially, start with the empty sequence. Each second, you do the following. With probability p a / ( p a + p b ) , add ' a ' to the end of the sequence. Otherwise (with probability p b / ( p a + p b ) ), add ' b ' to the end of the sequence. You stop once there are at least k subsequences that form ' ab '. Determine the expected number of times ' ab ' is a subsequence in the resulting sequence. It can be shown that this can be represented by P / Q , where P and Q are coprime integers, and . Print the value of .
input_specification: The first line will contain three integers integer k , p a , p b ( 1 ≤ k ≤ 1 000 , 1 ≤ p a , p b ≤ 1 000 000 ).
output_specification: Print a single integer, the answer to the problem.
approach_summary: Formulate expectation as E[X] = ∑ P(e) * v(e). Formulate linear transition equations on states and solve via DAG DP or Gaussian elimination.
